summary: The sole occurrence is the already quoted 96/164 Preterit example. Thin-cell status does not justify printing the same attestation again.
dʕəkke is active I Preterit with plural actors and an unmarked coordinated vegetation theme. The verse confirms trampling clover and fragrant herbs, not a new crushing or pushing sense.
Preserve the inherited dʕf/Arkaḥ etymological notes verbatim. They concern pushing and wind and are not additional corpus attestations of dʕk.
